title: 第23章 九天帝朝来犯第24章 融合不死神躯
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“无情，你还好吗？”忆无情一睁眼，冷清璃便出现在他身边。
忆无情看向冷清璃，笑道：“清璃，我问你个问题。”
“好。”
“你说……你修到帝境……是靠什么坚持下来的。”
闻言，冷清璃对上忆无情的目光，清冷的美眸带着一丝温柔。
“靠你。”
“我？”忆无情有些疑惑。
“曾经，我修行的意义就是为了不负师尊的期望，不负宗门的栽培，直到后来你的离去……我才知道，我修行的真正意义是什么。”
冷清璃缓缓伸出手，轻轻抚摸着忆无情的脸颊。
她继续道：“当时……我以为你走了，但我依旧怀着一丝希望，认为你不可能这么简单就走了，就像你曾经与我说的故事，主角总是会当所有人都以为他死了的时候关键出现。”
“我修行，就是为了有一天能进入通天古路，亲眼看看你……到底在不在。”
说着，冷清璃的脸轻轻靠近忆无情，在他脸上亲了一口。
“现在……我想做的……就是陪你，这就是我修行的意义，有时候我很庆幸，还好我成功证帝，不然……我就等不到你了。”
忆无情笑了起来：“我明白了，清璃……此生……定不负你。”
“嗯。”冷清璃微微颔首。
“走吧，不然师兄都要笑话我们了。”
“嗯。”
很快，忆无情与冷清璃便出现在寒月天山之巅。
“嗯？”忆无情一愣，他看见了一个小家伙独自坐在山崖上。
“那是……梦兮？”忆无情诧异道。

冷清璃也看到了柳梦兮，她走上前去，拍了拍柳梦兮的肩膀。
“梦兮，你在此地作甚？”
“啊……师……师尊，你来啦。”柳梦兮吓了一跳，连忙站起身。
“我……我在等你啊。”柳梦兮有些支吾，说话期间眼神不断四处瞟。
当看到不远处的忆无情时她眼神一亮，但又很快隐藏下去。
“何事？”冷清璃淡淡开口，随即好似想到什么，眼神微微有些寒意：“为师想问你，你为何会出现在通天古路之内呢？”
“这个……我……我……我想见见他呀。”柳梦兮指了指缓缓走过来的忆无情。
“我吗？”听到柳梦兮的话，忆无情指了指自己，有些疑惑。
“当然，我想看看你到底有什么魅力，能让师尊等你这么多年。”柳梦兮解释道。
“这不是借口，以你的修为，进去随便一只妖兽都能将你杀了，你还敢进去？”冷清璃冷漠道。
“没事清璃，我这不是已经将她带出来了吗，下次注意就好了。”忆无情劝道。
“对啊对啊，下次注意。”柳梦兮连忙附和。
“还想有下次？”冷清璃美眸一凝。
“没有了，没有了。”柳梦兮有些害怕，连忙跑到忆无情的身后。
“好了清璃，别生气了，她还小。”忆无情轻轻抚摸着柳梦兮的脑袋，无奈道。
content_en:
"Qingwu, are you okay?" As soon as Yi Qingqing opened his eyes, Leng Qingli appeared next to him.
Yi Qingqing looked at Leng Qingli and said with a smile: "Qingli, let me ask you a question."
"Okay."
"Tell me... how did you persist in cultivating to the imperial realm..."
Hearing this, Leng Qingli met Shang Yi's ruthless gaze, with a hint of tenderness in her cold beautiful eyes.
"It's up to you."
"Me?" Yi Qingqing was a little confused.
"In the past, the meaning of my practice was to live up to the expectations of my master and the cultivation of the sect. It was not until you left... that I realized what the true meaning of my practice was."
Leng Qingli slowly stretched out her hand and gently stroked Yi Wuqing's cheek.
She continued: "At that time... I thought you were gone, but I still had a glimmer of hope, thinking that you couldn't leave so easily. Just like the story you once told me, the protagonist would always appear when everyone thought he was dead."
"I practice so that one day I can enter the Tongtian Ancient Road and see with my own eyes whether you...are there or not."
After saying that, Leng Qingli's face gently approached Yi Qingqing's face and kissed him on the face.
"Now... what I want to do... is to accompany you. This is the meaning of my practice. Sometimes I am very lucky. Fortunately, I succeeded in becoming emperor. Otherwise... I wouldn't be able to wait for you."
Yi Qingqing laughed: "I understand, Qingli... I will definitely live up to you in this life."
"Yeah." Leng Qingli nodded slightly.
"Let's go, otherwise senior brother will laugh at us."
"Yeah."
Soon, Yi Wuqing and Leng Qingli appeared on the top of Hanyue Tianshan.
"Huh?" Yi Qingqing was stunned. He saw a little guy sitting alone on the cliff.
"Is that... Mengxi?" Yi Qingqing said in surprise.
Leng Qingli also saw Liu Mengxi. She walked forward and patted Liu Mengxi on the shoulder.
"Mengxi, what are you doing here?"
"Ah...Master...Master, you are here." Liu Mengxi was startled and stood up quickly.
"I...I'm waiting for you." Liu Mengxi faltered a little, her eyes constantly looking around as she spoke.
When she saw Yi Qingwu not far away, her eyes lit up, but she quickly hid it.
"What's the matter?" Leng Qingli said lightly, then she seemed to think of something, her eyes were slightly cold: "I would like to ask you, why did you appear in the Tongtian Ancient Road?"
"Well...I...I...I want to see him." Liu Mengxi pointed at Yi Qingqing, who was slowly walking over.
"Me?" After hearing Liu Mengxi's words, Yi Qingqing pointed at herself, feeling a little confused.
"Of course, I want to see what charm you have that makes Master wait for you for so many years." Liu Mengxi explained.
"This is not an excuse. With your cultivation level, any monster that goes in can kill you. How dare you go in?" Leng Qingli said coldly.
"It's okay Qingli, haven't I already brought her out? Just be careful next time." Yi Wuqing advised.
"Yes, yes, pay attention next time." Liu Mengxi quickly agreed.
"Do you still want a next time?" Leng Qingli's beautiful eyes narrowed.
"No more, no more." Liu Mengxi was a little scared and hurriedly ran behind Yi Wuqing.
"Okay Qingli, don't be angry, she's still young." Yi Wuqing gently stroked Liu Mengxi's head and said helplessly.
